metadata.description: Claude Agent Skills Stack: one plugin per skill, tracking main.

plugins.name: dockerfile-best-practices
plugins.description: Create and optimize Dockerfiles and Compose files: BuildKit, multi-stage builds, cache mounts, non-root hardening, plus the analyze_dockerfile and analyze_compose linters.

plugins.name: helm-bjw-s-chart
plugins.description: Generate production-ready Helm charts on the bjw-s-labs common library (app-template v5), with a chart validator.

plugins.name: automode-config
plugins.description: Author, validate and migrate Claude Code autoMode permission blocks behind a critique and sha256 gate. Ships the /automode-edit command.

plugins.name: apple-shortcuts
plugins.description: Generate importable Apple Shortcuts (.shortcut / plist XML) for macOS and iOS, including third-party app actions.
